events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us Abbey Road. That album cover, those tracks... still legendary. Which song is on repeat for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury was born on this day in 1946.

angles.name: Celebrating a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' formidable frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend whose influence continues to inspire. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Oasis Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your top Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album, Imagine, was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was a reality. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The visionary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your go-to track from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's extraordinary frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His legacy of incredible music and electrifying performances lives on. What's the Queen song that means the most to you?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, Rubber Soul, on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', marking a significant shift in their sound. Which track from this classic album is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' John Lennon in New York City.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His message of peace and incredible musical legacy continue to resonate deeply.
